findings.detail: Issuer-name extraction is absorbing schedule descriptors and terms instead of retaining only the portfolio company name; continuation debt rows should inherit the preceding company name.

rationale: The raw SOI columns show portfolio company names and investment terms as separate fields. For the cited continuation rows, the Portfolio Company cell is blank under an immediately preceding company total group, while type, date, maturity, rate, cost, and fair value occupy their own columns. The observed issuer_name values in the bundle instead concatenate those non-issuer fields and omit or pollute the actual issuer, so the fmt_issuer_name flag is a real extraction error.
